protocol.whiteboard_rule: 모든 서브에이전트는 작업 시작 전 .claude/whiteboard.json 을 읽고, 종료 전 반드시 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 자신의 상태(Status: Waiting|In Progress|Done)와 산출물 경로를 기록한다. 규칙을 어기고 종료 금지.
protocol.parallel_write_note: JSON 손상 방지: 병렬 에이전트는 공유 whiteboard.json 을 직접 쓰지 않고 각자 .claude/wb/<ROLE>.json 에 기록. PM 이 단일 writer 로 병합해 whiteboard.json 갱신.
protocol.unity_constraint: Unity batchmode 는 단일 배타 자원 → 빌드/검증(QA)만 직렬. 코드/에셋/사운드 제작은 병렬.

roles.PM: 전체 일정 관리 및 task.json 발행, whiteboard 병합, commit/close
roles.Director: 핵심 기획 및 아트/사운드 최종 승인 (feel/tone)
roles.Art: 에셋 생성 + 파이프라인 가이드 + 목업 검토
roles.QA: 버그 리포트 + 프로그램 검증 (Unity 빌드/하니스 - 단일 배타)
roles.AIDesigner: FSM/BT 등 AI 로직 설계 + 경로탐색 안전 제약

wave.lane_contract: STRICT file isolation. Lane A solely owns Assets/Scripts/AudioBank.cs this wave (add a 2nd 'danger' music clip slot + crossfade Play/StopDanger on a dedicated 2nd music AudioSource) AND NEW Assets/Scripts/MusicDirector.cs (self-attach driver polling AIDirector.Instance.CurrentThreatTier read-only; crossfades to danger track when tier>=2, back to calm when <2) — AIDirector.cs is NOT edited. Lane B solely owns Assets/Scripts/PawnInfoPanel.cs (add runtime-lazy tab strip 상태/건강/기분/장비 like the existing EnsureBorder lazy-create pattern; switching a tab changes which content rows are visible) — MUST NOT touch its SceneSetup builder, ClickSelector, or any other file; scene-wiring (if any new SerializeField) FLAGGED for QA, default to runtime lazy-create so no scene edit is needed. Lane C owns a NEW PlayMode/EditMode test file under the existing test asmdef only (raid@day3 + bandit-paths-to-colony assertions; same asmdef as V4CombatChainTest/V5FoodChainTest; touches NO runtime .cs and NO existing test file). Lane D owns NEW Assets/Scripts/WeatherParticleDriver.cs ONLY (self-attach via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod] like RainSoundDriver/FlickerLight; reads WeatherController.Instance.Current read-only; creates+drives a Unity ParticleSystem rain/snow layer in code, no prefab/scene edit; visible during Storm, none during Clear) — WeatherController.cs is NOT edited, and it does NOT touch AudioBank/RainSoundDriver. No SceneSetup*.cs / SceneSetup.Pawn.cs / SceneSetup.Game.Entities.cs / SceneSetup.Game.Audio.cs touched by any lane. No two lanes touch the same file. Cross-file deps: A reads AIDirector.CurrentThreatTier (read-only public prop, no edit); D reads WeatherController.Current (read-only, same prop RainSoundDriver already polls — two distinct driver files reading the same prop is safe). A owns AudioBank.cs this wave (B/C/D do NOT touch it).
subtasks: Lane A (game-sound-designer, M2 dynamic-music #8): Assets/Scripts/AudioBank.cs AND NEW Assets/Scripts/MusicDirector.cs ONLY (both solely owned by this lane; AIDirector.cs NOT edited). In AudioBank.cs add a 'dangerBgm' AudioClip slot + a dedicated 2nd music AudioSource (or reuse a crossfade pair) + PlayDangerMusic()/StopDangerMusic() that crossfade between the calm bgm and the danger track over ~1s (graceful null no-op; generate a danger.wav + .meta following the prior _gen_m2_sfx.py / ForceUpdate meta pattern — a tense low-drone/percussive bed, loopable). In NEW MusicDirector.cs (self-attach via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] like RainSoundDriver) poll AIDirector.Instance.CurrentThreatTier each frame: on tier>=2 call AudioBank.PlayDangerMusic(), on tier<2 call StopDangerMusic() (state-machine guard like RainSoundDriver._lastKind to avoid per-frame restart). MUST NOT edit AIDirector.cs, WeatherController.cs, RainSoundDriver.cs, or any entity/SceneSetup file. NOTE scene-side SerializeField wiring of dangerBgm on the AudioBank GameObject is required -> FLAG for QA (same pattern as prior sfxBuild/alert/ambient/mine/rain wiring). Wiki acceptance #8: music swaps to the tension track during a raid (threat>=2) and back when clear.

Lane B (game-programmer, M6 inspector-tabs #23): Assets/Scripts/PawnInfoPanel.cs ONLY. Add a runtime-lazy tab strip (상태 / 건강 / 기분 / 장비) using the SAME lazy-create pattern as the existing EnsureBorder method (build the tab buttons + content groups in code on first show, NOT in a SceneSetup builder). Clicking a tab changes which content rows are visible (e.g. 상태=needs bars, 건강=healthText, 기분=mood detail, 장비=equipment placeholder). MUST NOT touch its SceneSetup builder, ClickSelector.cs, AudioBank.cs, or any other file. If a tab needs data the panel does not already read, show a styled placeholder rather than reaching into new runtime APIs. Default to runtime lazy-create so NO scene edit is needed; if any new SerializeField is truly unavoidable, FLAG it for QA. Wiki acceptance #23: inspector shows tabs; switching tabs changes content.

Lane C (game-build-engineer, M5 verify #27 raid-threat): NEW test file under the existing PlayMode/EditMode test asmdef ONLY (same asmdef as V4CombatChainTest.cs / V5FoodChainTest.cs; add a new V7_RaidThreat test .cs, do NOT edit existing test files or any runtime .cs). Assert as ONE binary PASS: a raid/bandit spawns on day 3 (advance GameClock.Day to 3 / force the storyteller raid path the same way prior tests drive managers) AND the spawned bandit moves TOWARD the colony (its position closes distance to a colony reference point over a short sim window). Use the existing TestRunner harness conventions + the same bootstrap pattern V4/V5 used (manager bootstrap, manual component add where needed). If a runtime API needed to force the raid or read bandit position is missing, FLAG it for QA rather than editing runtime. Wiki acceptance #27: a gated test asserts a bandit spawns day 3 and moves toward the colony.

Lane D (game-artist, M1 weather-particles #14): NEW Assets/Scripts/WeatherParticleDriver.cs ONLY (self-attach via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] like RainSoundDriver/FlickerLight). On bootstrap create a screen-space-ish (camera-following) Unity ParticleSystem in code for falling rain (and optionally snow) — set rate/velocity/size for a subtle downward streak layer rendered ABOVE ground but it must NOT compete with pawn saturation (low alpha, cool desaturated tint per palette WATER_* / cream). Poll WeatherController.Instance.Current read-only each frame: emit during WeatherKind.Storm, stop/clear emission during Clear (state-machine guard to avoid per-frame restart). MUST NOT edit WeatherController.cs, AudioBank.cs, RainSoundDriver.cs, or any SceneSetup/entity file; no prefab or scene edit (build the ParticleSystem entirely in code, mirroring how FlickerLight/RainSoundDriver self-attach). NOTE if a tiny particle texture is needed, generate a NEW small PNG + .meta (Point filter) rather than editing an existing sprite. Wiki acceptance #14: during a storm a rain particle layer is visible; clear weather has none.
